name: Bund
description: Shanghai’s iconic waterfront promenade, known for its historic architecture and skyline views across the Huangpu River.

name: Nanjing Road
description: Shanghai’s major commercial boulevard, combining pedestrian shopping areas, historic buildings and vibrant city activity.

name: Yu Yuan Garden
description: A classical Chinese garden in Shanghai’s Old City, featuring traditional architecture, rockeries, ponds and landscaped courtyards.

name: Tianzifang
description: A historic lane neighbourhood characterized by shikumen architecture, small shops, cafés, galleries and creative businesses.

name: Pudong
description: Shanghai’s modern eastern urban district, associated with the city’s financial skyline and contemporary development.

name: Sightseeing Tunnel
description: An underground pedestrian tunnel beneath the Huangpu River connecting the Bund area with Lujiazui.

name: Shanghai Tower
description: China’s tallest skyscraper and a defining element of Shanghai’s contemporary skyline in Lujiazui.

name: Zhujiajiao
description: An ancient water town on the outskirts of Shanghai, characterized by canals, historic buildings and stone bridges.

name: Bund Light Show
description: A nighttime visual spectacle along the Huangpu waterfront featuring illuminated buildings and the Shanghai skyline.

name: Apoli Itabakery
description: A popular bakery in Shanghai’s Changning area known for Italian-style breads, pastries and a distinctive European-inspired interior.

name: Wukang Building
description: An iconic historic apartment building designed by László Hudec, located at the intersection of Wukang Road and Huaihai Middle Road.

name: Subdued
description: A fashion store on Wukang Road known for contemporary women’s clothing and a youthful retail atmosphere.

name: Wulumuqi Road
description: A tree-lined street in the former French Concession area, associated with Shanghai’s local neighbourhood and lifestyle experience.

name: Anfu Road
description: A popular lifestyle street in the former French Concession area, known for cafés, independent shops, fashion stores and street scenes.

name: Jing’an Temple View Bridge
description: An urban viewing point associated with Shanghai’s Jing’an area and its contemporary cityscape.

name: Yu Bazaar
description: A traditional-style commercial area surrounding Yu Garden, featuring shops, food stalls and tourist-oriented streetscapes.

name: French Concession
description: Historic central Shanghai district characterized by tree-lined streets, villas, cafés and a distinctive urban lifestyle atmosphere.

name: Gentle Monster
description: A visually distinctive Korean eyewear retail space combining fashion, experimental installations and immersive store design.

name: Shanghai Greenhouse Gardens
description: A garden and greenhouse environment offering a green-space experience within Shanghai’s dense urban setting.

name: Matcha Tokyo
description: A Japanese-style matcha and dessert venue associated with contemporary café culture in Shanghai.

name: Brandy Melville
description: A fashion retail store associated with the youthful shopping and lifestyle scene around Shanghai’s former French Concession.

name: Xintiandi
description: A regenerated urban district combining traditional shikumen architecture with contemporary restaurants, retail and entertainment.

name: M50 Creative Space
description: A contemporary art district converted from former industrial buildings, featuring galleries, studios, graffiti and creative spaces.

name: Old Millfun
description: A preserved 1930s industrial slaughterhouse complex known for its distinctive concrete architecture and historic industrial character.

name: Gucheng Park
description: An urban park in Shanghai’s Old City area, located between Yu Garden and the Bund and associated with the city’s historic urban fabric.

name: Wukang Mansion
description: A protected historic apartment building in the former French Concession, designed by László Hudec in a French Renaissance style.
